content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms are restricted, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-4|Digital Product]] creators face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-10|setting]] up online stores. With platforms like Stripe and PayPal unavailable, creators must look for alternative infrastructure solutions to sell their digital products and receive payments. This is where COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure comes in, providing a reliable and efficient way to deploy online stores with automatic crypto payment processing.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to COREMERCH's infrastructure is its use of decentralized and open-source technologies, such as GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Supabase. These tools allow creators to host their stores and manage orders without relying on centralized platforms. By leveraging NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, creators can receive payments directly to their wallets, eliminating the need for intermediaries. This approach ensures that creators maintain full control over their stores and customer data.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you'll need to prepare a few essential components. First, you'll need to set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your store. Next, you'll need to create a Supabase instance to manage your orders and customer data. Finally, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments account to enable crypto payment processing. With these components in place, you'll be ready to deploy your store and start accepting payments.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Supabase instance. This will enable automatic payment verification and order fulfillment. You'll also need to configure your store's frontend to display your products and accept payments. With Cloudflare Workers, you can create a seamless and secure checkout experience for your customers. By leveraging these tools, you can create a fully functional payment and delivery pipeline that streamlines your sales process.
Deploy a fully functional digital store with automatic crypto payment processing in just 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've deployed your store and configured your payment pipeline, you're ready to go live and start accepting payments. With NOWPayments, you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving your customers a wide range of payment options. When a customer makes a payment, NOWPayments will automatically verify the transaction and trigger order fulfillment. You'll receive notification of the payment and can then deliver the digital product to your customer. This seamless process ensures that you can focus on creating and selling your products, rather than managing payments and orders.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows and you start to receive more payments, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to ensure that it can handle the increased traffic. With Supabase, you can easily scale your database to accommodate more orders and customer data. Cloudflare Pages and Workers also provide automatic scaling, ensuring that your store remains fast and responsive even under heavy load. By leveraging these scalable technologies, you can focus on growing your business, rather than worrying about infrastructure limitations.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can use COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack, which includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. This stack allows you to deploy a fully functional store with automatic crypto payment processing, without relying on centralized platforms. With this infrastructure, you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies and receive payments directly to your wallet.
Accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments, giving your customers a wide range of payment options.

For a more comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack provides a more advanced infrastructure for managing orders and customer data, and includes features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for enhanced security. You can learn more about the Edge Commerce Stack and other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store, follow these steps: set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account, create a Supabase instance, configure your NOWPayments account, integrate NOWPayments with Supabase, configure your store's frontend, and test your payment pipeline. With these steps complete, you'll be ready to go live and start accepting payments. For a more streamlined process, consider purchasing the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes 30-day support and end-to-end testing.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?
Stack 01 is a more basic infrastructure solution, while Stack 02 is a more comprehensive solution that includes advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, using COREMERCH's infrastructure solutions.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with Supabase?
You can integrate NOWPayments with Supabase by following the instructions in the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a step-by-step guide to configuring your payment pipeline.
What is the benefit of using Supabase for order management?
Supabase provides a scalable and secure solution for managing orders and customer data, allowing you to focus on growing your business rather than managing infrastructure.
How do I scale my infrastructure as my store grows?
You can scale your infrastructure by leveraging the automatic scaling features of Cloudflare Pages and Workers, and by upgrading your Supabase instance to accommodate more orders and customer data.
Scale your infrastructure seamlessly with Cloudflare Pages and Workers, and focus on growing your business rather than managing infrastructure limitations.
